content.comment_body: Hello, I am experiencing the same issue—the timer delay shows up on the operator panel and I can modify it there. Unfortunately, the value only changes on the panel, but not on the [product_name] controller itself. This message was moved from another thread about [product_name] and operator panel problems.

A new question posted by [user_name] has been split into a different thread with the topic '[product_name], unable to upload program, PC and controller are not on the same subnet.' Best regards [user_name]
I don't want a screenshot; I need the actual program you created.

analysis.insight_summary: There is a synchronization issue, as changes made to the timer delay from the operator panel are not reflected in the [product_name] controller. Users request the program file, indicating that the root cause may be related to how the program has been set up or configured.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects that updating timer delay values from the operator panel will automatically apply the changes to the [product_name] controller, enabling real-time parameter updates.
